narrative.hook: If you're thinking about selling in Natomas, new construction is part of your competition.

cta.text: Want a local read on where your home fits? Let's talk.

narrative.notice: Based on information from MetroList Services, Inc. for the period Feb 19, 2026 through Oct 19, 2026.
narrative.narrationTagged: [conversational] If you're thinking about selling in Natomas, new construction is part of your competition. Buyers have options. So what does the resale market actually show? Active listings are sitting a median of 41 days before going under contract. Homes that closed sold at 99.4% of list price on average. [thoughtful] But here in the active market, 6 of 14 listings have already taken a price reduction. That gap between homes that sold and homes that didn't tells a real story. [emphasis] Condition and pricing precision matter. New construction sets a baseline—your home has to answer for itself. [warm] Want to talk through where your home fits in that picture? I'm happy to walk you through it.
